dedupe_keys.name: niger delta oil rim reservoir properties grid design and well trajectories

description: This deposit documents inputs for a synthetic oil-rim reservoir model based on Niger Delta reservoir information. Covenant University researchers provide grid dimensions, well trajectories and rock-fluid relationships to study oil production during gas-cap blowdown. The grid design includes twenty vertical cells and a six-degree dip, with porosity and other properties supporting reserves estimates. Current Mendeley version 2 contains a Word document free under CC BY 4.0; the article cites version 1. Coverage is a constructed reservoir example, not a field production time series. The release inventory does not establish that an executable Eclipse input deck is included, and reservoir-specific assumptions limit generalization. A reviewer-assessed use is reconstructing comparative water- or gas-injection scenarios after translating the documented inputs. No directly related reservoir-simulation record was established in the catalogue. No document payload, simulator or recovery calculation was run.
